name: Alajuela

median_age.source: INEC Costa Rica, X Censo Nacional de Población y VI de Vivienda 2011, tabulated on INEC's REDATAM base 2011

sex_ratio.source: INEC Costa Rica, X Censo Nacional de Población y VI de Vivienda 2011, tabulated on INEC's REDATAM base 2011

religion.note: Costa Rica's census does not ask religion. INEC's REDATAM base of the 2011 census holds, for every person, relationship, sex, age, birthplace and arrival, P07 whether indigenous, P08 which people, P09 whether they speak an indigenous language, P10 ethnic-racial self-identification, social security, disability, schooling, ICT use, residence five years before, marital status, occupation, industry, place of work and children born. Religion is not among them.

language.note: Costa Rica's census has no language question for the population. The 2011 census asks only whether a person who said they are indigenous speaks an indigenous language (P09: its 'No Aplica' is everyone P07 did not count as indigenous, 4,197,569 people), which is not a composition of what anybody speaks.

sources.name: INEC Costa Rica, X Censo Nacional de Población y VI de Vivienda 2011, tabulated on INEC's REDATAM base 2011

adapter_hint: Wikidata population, capital and coordinates for every country: python scripts/fetch_wikidata.py --level admin2 --countries CRI
median_age_note: Interpolated within the single year of age that holds the middle person, from INEC's count of everyone by single year of age in the 2011 census.
sex_ratio_note: Males per 1,000 females in OCHA's COD-PS for this country, reference year 2021, built from the country's official population figures; for a year after the last census, a projection.
ethnicity_note: The 2011 census asked everyone whether they consider themselves indigenous (P07) and, if so, which people they belong to (P08) -- the indigenous lines here, including those of a people from another country and those who named none; everyone else was asked their ethnic-racial self-identification (P10), which makes the other lines. Of the 848,146 people counted, 16,920 answered P10 "Ignorado" and are left out of the shares.
